index.name: Studio fixture / Studio notes
index.intended_use: Reusable reference for a small text-led monochrome interface; candidate handoff only.

hierarchy.value: Strong heading/action contrast is suggested by a 2rem h1 and inverted action against the page.
hierarchy.counterexample_or_limit: The document has only one heading level; UA heading weight/margins and action font are unknown.
hierarchy.tradeoff_inference: Prioritizes a short note-and-action reading order; exact salience requires rendering.
hierarchy.confidence_basis: Direct source declarations plus limited AI interpretation; not a calibrated probability.

density.value: Moderate declared grouping: 24px outer padding, 16px grid gap and panel padding, 8px vertical action padding.
density.counterexample_or_limit: UA paragraph/heading margins stack with grid gaps; wide grid items may stretch. Compact rule reduces only padding.
density.tradeoff_inference: Reusable spacing relationships are stronger evidence than a numeric density rating.
density.confidence_basis: Direct source declarations plus limited AI interpretation; not a calibrated probability.

contrast_character.value: Two-color near-black/white palette; page and action swap foreground/background roles, with dark preference inversion.
contrast_character.counterexample_or_limit: Hover opacity blends the whole action with the backdrop; currentColor focus can match the page background. No rendered contrast certification.
contrast_character.tradeoff_inference: Clear tonal separation with little hue coding; functional feedback needs additional decisions.
contrast_character.confidence_basis: Direct source declarations plus limited AI interpretation; not a calibrated probability.

typography.value: System-led body text plus one explicitly larger heading size.
typography.counterexample_or_limit: No exact installed font, body size/line-height, weights or button inheritance specified.
typography.tradeoff_inference: Portable platform voice; less deterministic cross-platform metrics.
typography.confidence_basis: Direct source declarations plus limited AI interpretation; not a calibrated probability.

geometry.value: Restrained geometry: 4px action radius, square unrounded panel declaration, thin 1px panel border.
geometry.counterexample_or_limit: 4px focus offset is a different semantic role despite matching radius value. UA button border remains.
geometry.tradeoff_inference: Control softness contrasts with structural panel edges; no broad radius scale proven.
geometry.confidence_basis: Direct source declarations plus limited AI interpretation; not a calibrated probability.

imagery.value: No imagery or iconography is declared in the supplied source.
imagery.counterexample_or_limit: Does not establish whether the wider product uses media; no asset license can be inferred.
imagery.tradeoff_inference: Text-led reference only; image treatment remains unknown.
imagery.confidence_basis: Direct source declarations plus limited AI interpretation; not a calibrated probability.

motion.value: One opacity hover rule; no transition duration or animation is declared.
motion.counterexample_or_limit: No exercised hover, touch or reduced-motion state. Browser-native effects are outside inspection.
motion.tradeoff_inference: A restrained-motion interpretation is limited to author declarations, not measured behavior.
motion.confidence_basis: Direct source declarations plus limited AI interpretation; not a calibrated probability.

rating_note: No score requested; index is descriptive. Unknown dimensions and runtime checks do not receive zero scores.
